x: بِسْمِ الـلّٰـهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيْمِ
Bismi llāhi r-Raḥmāni r-Raḥīm
In the name of Allāh, the All-Merciful, the Ever-Merciful
كَفَاكَ رَبُّكَ كَمْ يَكْفِيْكَ وَاكِفَةً
Kafāka rabbuka kam yakfīka wākifatan
Your Lord has sufficed you — how much does He suffice you, pouring down
كِفْكَافُهَا كَكَمِيْنٍ كَانَ مِنْ لِكَاكٍ
kifkāfuhā ka-kamīnin kāna min likāki
its downpour like an ambush that came from close pressing
تَكُرُّ كَرًّا كَكَرِّ الْكَرِّ فِـيْ كَبَدٍ
takurru karran ka-karri l-karri fī kabadin
charging charge upon charge, as charge follows charge in hardship
تَـحْكِىْ مُشَكْشَكَةً كَلَكْلَكِ لَكَّاكٍ
taḥkī mushakshakatan ka-lakalaki lakkāki
recounting a piercing thing, like the breast-bone of one who strikes hard
كَفَىٰ مَا بِـيْ كَفَاكَ الْكَافُ كُرْبَتَهُ
kafā mā biya, kafāka l-kāfu kurbatah
enough is what is upon me — the kāf has sufficed you of its distress
يَا كَوْكَبًا كَانَ يَـحْكِيْ كَوْكَبَ الفَلَكِ
yā kawkaban kāna yaḥkī kawkaba l-falaki
O star that was the very likeness of the star of the heavens
